svg.title: Mateus Engeroff
svg.desc: Mateus Engeroff, software engineering portfolio. Building real software while learning how it should be built. Software development intern at CABERGS and computer science student at Unisinos. Based in Porto Alegre, Brazil, open to roles in Brazil and abroad. A vertical branch graph lists the featured projects: Agent Command Center (in development), Collaborative Web Platform (in development), VAULT//SHIFT (prototype), Project Structure Mapper (completed).
